method: Count every cmap code point in each fixed Unicode 17 CJK Unified Ideographs block; block slots include unassigned values so results do not depend on the host Unicode database.
decisionRationale: The familiar U+20BB7 sample is present, but the locked production face covers only 2108 of 42720 Extension B slots, 202 slots in Extensions C through G combined, and no slots in Extensions H, I or J. A few named samples therefore cannot establish rare-Han coverage.

candidate.projectCoverageClaim: CJK Unified Ideographs Extensions B through J

acceptance.policy: Each required block must gain coverage over the Noto baseline, and the combined production registry must render the pinned cross-block sample without tofu. The packaged-candidate gate separately proves the same registered bytes ship.
